title: Wear-Crash on settings change
body:
```

```

The commit introducing the issue seems to be this one:
https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/commit/93e9d3be2b74ab8099d42e6f4ebae1a6def38c95#diff-2fe96e74ad12748a3a7c51ce3bf38ccf

It does not like waiting on an UI-Thread:
`NodeApi.GetLocalNodeResult localnodes = Wearable.NodeApi.getLocalNode(googleApiClient).await(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS);`

I'm not sure if I enabled "force wear" from the phone or the watch.
